mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last two months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last two months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last two months signals increased economic activity and supply, which is bullish for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 1%) signals a supportive monetary environment, which encourages risk-taking and investment in equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% over the last two months, it signals a strengthening consumer demand and labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% and an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the last month signals a robust labor market, which is bullish for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.5% and PAYEMS increases > 100,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over the last quarter signals strong economic growth, which is bullish for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
